AfterCombatVictory.rationale: BlackBlood.cs:9-16 heals HealVar(12m).BaseValue on combat VICTORY if the owner is not dead. The sim's on_combat_end carries the player_won flag (relics/base.py:18 maps AfterCombatVictory to exactly this), and the port checks both `player_won` and `not self.player.is_dead` (black_blood.py:18) -- the same pair. 12 matches with no AscensionHelper branch in the file. The IsDead guard is not redundant on either side: a victory can coincide with the player's death (simultaneous lethal Thorns), which is exactly the case the guard exists for.

guards.rationale: RelicModel.Flash() / base.Status / ShowCounter / DisplayAmount / CanonicalVars / ExtraHoverTips / Cmd.Wait / CardCmd.Preview are presentation only -- the relic bar's glow, counter and hover text, and animation timing. The sim has no relic UI. Waived under the shared contract's presentation/animation exclusion, not under an unreachability claim.

guards.what: N2: AfterCombatVictory only -- neither side heals after a combat the player did not win
guards.rationale: C# overrides AfterCombatVictory, not AfterCombatEnd, so a fled/lost combat heals nothing; the sim's `if player_won` reproduces that. Recorded because the sim's Relic base offers BOTH an on_combat_end combat hook and a run-level after_combat_end (relics/base.py:251), and picking the wrong one would heal on defeat.
